name: SurgeModuleTool
description: Surge module updater for Scripting: batch-update #SUBSCRIBED modules, install from URL, and redirect scriptable:// links to scripting:// with a Surge module plus a built-in Safari browser script.

localizedDescriptions.zh: Surge 模块更新器：批量更新带 #SUBSCRIBED 的本地模块、从链接安装，并通过 Surge 模块与内置浏览器脚本把 scriptable:// 跳转到 scripting://。
